R52 dependency audit (source and public metadata only; no imports/installs/tests).
Runtime requirements and constraints apply ONLY to backend/X-Voice. Qwen/vLLM remains a separate environment with its own resolver; never apply backend torch pins to vLLM implicitly.
Vendor project pip installation is unnecessary: supervisor PYTHONPATH provides translator/backend and xvoice/src. The active path uses importlib.resources.files on source namespaces, not installed xvoice/translator distribution metadata. Do not resolve either upstream pyproject's broad default extras.
Actual route: backend.app -> session/services/speaker_prompt -> ModelScope speaker_verification_light + DTDNN CAM++; server.xvoice -> utils_infer -> model CFM/CFM_SFT/DiT + rate_pred.SpeedPredictor + IPA v3/v6 tokenizers + text_normalizer.
Trainer and Trainer_SFT package exports are now lazy __getattr__ exports. Their public names remain available to explicit training callers; inference no longer imports wandb/accelerate/ema_pytorch or training datasets through those exports. ModelScope pipeline.base itself imports MsDataset, hence ModelScope[framework]/datasets/oss2 remain real runtime requirements.
Selected core constraints: torch/torchaudio2.8.0 fromCUDA12.8 index; numpy1.26.4; transformers4.48.3 withtokenizers0.21 family/huggingface-hub<1; modelscope1.20.0 withitsDECLAREDframework datasets>=3.0,<=3.0.1 andsetuptools69.5.1; x-transformers1.31.14 (upstream minimum); Vocos0.1.0. PublicPyPI requires_dist snapshots are adjacent. Datasets2.21 metadata was inspected but is NOT selected, because the chosen ModelScope framework specifies3.0.x.
Whisper0.10.1 is an OPTIONAL eval extra in XVoice, not a default requirement. CT2 4.5.0 is declared by upstream but absent from active Stage2/controller imports. Gradio is only infer_gradio, DeepFilterNet function-local andexplicitlydisabled, fastlid import skipped underfixedEnglishmode, torchcodec absentfromsource andnotrequiredby torchaudio2.8 metadata. No ONNXRuntime is used by torchCAM++/XVoice/Vocos. Allareomitted.
Englishnormalizer uses Nemo text grammar +num2words; IPA uses provisioned private espeak. Pythonimports ofpyopenjtalk/g2pk/pythainlp are retainedbecauseactualtokenizer modulesimportthem, although Englishdoesnotactivateforeign-language data paths. No additionalpretrainedweightsare claimednecessary.
Compatibility evidence is metadata/source only. Root must install undertheseconstraints andrecordpipcheck/freeze beforeanymodeltest. No successfulinstallation orCUDAexecution is claimed here.
ModelScope source audit URLs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelscope/modelscope/v1.20.0/ + pathencodedin *.source.txt filename; speaker-light andDTDNN aliases correspond modelscope/pipelines/audio/speaker_verification_light_pipeline.py andmodelscope/models/audio/sv/DTDNN.py. OriginalAlibaba copyright headers retained.
